modules.module_title: Select the site and system for beekeeping

pcs.pc_description: select a site for beekeeping ensuring it has the required temperature and Relative Humidity (RH), ensuring no dampness at the site
ensure the presence of nectar and pollen yielding flowers in the recommended quantity near the site, along with trees for shading and a source of clean water
ensure the site does not experience waterlogging
carry out cost-benefit analysis and select an appropriate beekeeping system, after considering the economic aspects of different beekeeping systems

modules.module_title: Arrange the required resources and plan beekeeping operations

pcs.pc_description: select an approved vendor based on the price and quality of required tools, equipment, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and accessories, such as top bar hive/ Langstroth hive, smoker, honey extractor, comb foundation sheet, de-capping knife, bee brush, feeder, etc.
purchase the required resources according to the requirement and store them appropriately
plan the beekeeping operations according to the flowering season to ensure easy availability of nectar and pollen for the optimum growth of bees
select a location for the installation of beehives within the recommended distance from the flower field/ forest
assemble the beehives using the recommended type of wood and other relevant materials
apply the paint of recommended colour on the beehives according to the temperature of the region, to maintain the temperature in beehives, ensuring not to paint the inside
set up the queen excluder as per the requirement
install the beehives with rectangular frames inside them, and stack them on wooden stands appropriately to ensure stability and easy access for their management
hang beehives as planned using strong and greased galvanised wires

modules.module_title: Select, procure and introduce bees in beehives

pcs.pc_description: select the appropriate species of bee for apiculture, ensuring it produces the required quality of honey and has the recommended life span

select an approved vendor and purchase the package of selected bee species, ensuring the presence of queen bee, worker bees and male bees in the required number or coordinate with an expert to catch bees from the wild, ensuring the bees are healthy
clean the beehives thoroughly before introducing bees in them
introduce bees in beehives following the recommended procedure, maintaining the recommended number of bees in each beehive

modules.module_title: Harvest honey and other bee produce

pcs.pc_description: identify the honeycombs containing ripe honey which are sealed, with a fine layer of beeswax
arrange the relevant tools and equipment for extracting honey such as hive tool, smoker, honey extractor, etc.
select an appropriate time for harvesting honey and other raw produce
follow the recommended practices to extract honey, propolis, pollen, royal jelly and bee venom from honeycombs, using the recommended PPE and equipment
ensure no harm to bees during the raw produce extraction process
unfreeze honeycombs with hot water, steam or solar heat, and filter the melted honeycombs to obtain yellow beeswax
bleach the yellow beeswax with the recommended oxidizing agent such as hydrogen peroxide, sulphuric acid, or sunlight to obtain white beeswax
collect the extracted produce in separate and clean containers, protecting it from contamination, ensuring minimum loss
grade honey and other produce based on applicable grading parameters such as ripeness, colour, taste, purity, etc.
sort out the produce based on their shelf-life
pack honey and other produce in suitable packaging and label it with the relevant information in compliance with the applicable regulatory guidelines
store the packed honey at the recommended temperature and humidity, ensuring the storage area is hygienic, dry and protected from direct sunlight
identify the potential buyers and markets for honey and other bee produce such as eMandi, local traders, exporters, etc.
negotiate with the buyers to secure a profitable price for the produce
arrange an appropriate mode of transport to ensure safe and hygienic delivery of produce to the buyer
process the payment using the buyer- preferred e-payment method
maintain the manual and/ or electronic record of sales and payments using the physical registers and/ or the relevant computer application
